default.help_desc: For detailed help on each command, use:

scale.description: Provides tools to scale down different components of a MATSim simulation, such as population files.

create.description: Provides tools to create new simulation components from source data, like GTFS.

commands.name: pt
commands.desc: Creates a public transit schedule from GTFS data.

edit.description: This module is under development and will provide tools for editing simulation files.

population.description:
High-performance XML population processor that handles chunking, coordinate transformation (MTM8 to WGS84), spatial binning, and agent scaling.
Processes the specified population XML file and outputs MATSim-compatible scaled files.

flags.name: -s, --scale
flags.desc: Target population scale factor. When not specified, automatically determines and produces up to 10 different scales (1% to 10%) based on population analysis

flags.name: -c, --clean
flags.desc: Clean up temporary files after processing

config_info: Configuration is managed through a YAML file (local ./config.yaml or global).
Use '--new-config' to create a new config file interactively.
Key settings: chunk_size, output_dir, language, database.*

pt.description: Sophisticated GTFS data processor that performs multi-step transit analysis through a sequential pipeline. Handles file validation, service pattern analysis, route mapping, and stop sequence processing.
config_info: Configuration is managed through a YAML file (local ./config.yaml or global).
Use '--new-config' to create a new config file interactively.
Database settings (database.*) are required for PT analysis.

time_periods.name: work
time_periods.desc: (default) Selects and processes ONE random day from Monday through Friday

time_periods.name: week
time_periods.desc: Selects and processes ONE random day from Saturday or Sunday

time_periods.name: DD-MM-YY
time_periods.desc: Processes data for a specific date (e.g., 15-04-25)
